_comment: Kiosk rotation. Edit this list, then run scripts/build-kiosk.py (or scripts/push-cycle.sh <ip...>). Slide types: home | event | network | stats | citizen | momentum | feature | brand | poster | image | calendar. For an event, 'url' is the only required field; everything else is pulled from Luma, and the slide drops out of rotation by itself once the event ends. Optional per-event overrides: title, subtitle, badge, tagline, cover, venue. 'after': <url of an event listed earlier> keeps a slide hidden until that event has ended (use it to queue a replacement in the same slot). 'ms' is dwell time in milliseconds. Keep event slides apart so no two play back to back.
